blocks.source: Vol III, Trajectory Curation, § From Trajectory Records to a Training Corpus
blocks.md: The evaluation harness of a later section and the operational record of a later section produced more than a release decision. While they judged the repair agent (a later section) over repeated attempts on the connection-pool repair task, they also accumulated a durable trajectory log. The log captures every trial in granular detail: the environment observations delivered to the model, the code edits it proposed, the invalid tool calls rejected by the runtime, the subsequent recovery steps, and the final verdict scored against the task acceptance criteria.
